mechanic: Wear log per joint (0-3), a flare shield with overload gates (what load the joint took and how it answered), and movement notes — guard, don't guess.

mechanic: Twelve door cards (Anger, Need, Shame, Control, Permission…): write what is behind the door, then a letter back from that part — a structure, not a vague prompt dump.

mechanic: Script builder: four fill-in fields (This matters to me… When… I need… And here is what I can offer), a rehearsal star rating, then a doorway log of which script you actually used.

mechanic: One dial a day (pressure 0-10), three neutral fields (body, work, one good thing), and a garage protocol — a practical reset list with no jargon and no grading.

mechanic: Bridge: trigger (what happened), rupture (what you did), pause (the 10-minute rule), repair (one sentence to repair). Plus a weekly weather report for the relationship, not the market.

mechanic: Done ladder: five rungs (v1 rough, v2 usable, v3 good, v4 better, v5 perfect-never), check what version you have, note sunk cost, then a ship-it gate when the rung is good enough.

mechanic: Gauge before and after social time (charge 0-10), a recharge map (what actually recharges you, from a menu), and a script wallet of three small-talk exits.
